text:
amy (support): FYI customer Tim (AcmeCorp) reporting lots of 5xx/timeouts from hosted endpoint in us-west-2 since ~09:20 UTC. p95->p99 tail spikes, lots of 502/504. ticket INC-8912 :rotating_light:

tim (customer-ops): example curl they sent:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"input": "status"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
Response: 504 Gateway Timeout
Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d

opsbot: autoscaler: batcher-pool-usw2 checked at 2024-11-06T09:24:12Z, desired=12, available=12 (no scaling) :information_source:

devon (eng-runtime): Can you paste the request IDs and model they hit? Any auth/billing errors?

amy (support): No auth/billing errors in logs. Model: redwood-1-large (hosted). Recent sample request IDs: req_0a1b2c3d, req_0a1b2c3e, req_0a1b2c3f. Customer says it happens on bursts of ~300 req/s.

lisa (sre): Quick check: are we hitting queue depth or continuous-batcher backlog? I saw a metric alert for batcher_enqueued_count and queue_depth_usw2.

amy (support): pasted a short log excerpt from batcher service (09:20-09:26):
```
[2024-11-06T09:21:03Z] WARN enqueue_time_ms=1120 queue_depth=492 batchers_backlog=18 kvcache_misses=9 upstream_err=502 req=req_0a1b2c3d
[2024-11-06T09:22:14Z] WARN enqueue_time_ms=1890 queue_depth=512 batchers_backlog=23 kvcache_misses=12 upstream_err=504 req=req_0a1b2c3e
[2024-11-06T09:23:45Z] ERROR dequeue_timeout_ms=30000 queue_depth=512 batchers_blocked=true req=req_0a1b2c3f
```

devon (eng-runtime): That looks like queue depth clipped at 512 and continuous-batcher backlog building. Likely long KV cache cold misses + large seq lengths causing slow generations and backlog.

raj (eng-oncall): Mitigation options: (1) route this tenant to lower-latency variant (redwood-1-small) temporarily, (2) reduce max_batch_size or prefer_low_latency policy for that route, (3) enable aggressive early-reject for oversized requests. Which is fastest?

amy (support): Customer needs minimum disruption. Tim says they can accept lower throughput if latency improves.

devon (eng-runtime): Quick action: I'll flip routing to prefer-low-latency and reduce max_batch_size to 8 for the tenant's route in us-west-2. That should reduce enqueue_time. Doing change now and I'll monitor.

opsbot: config-change: route:update tenant=acmecorp region=us-west-2 policy=prefer-low-latency max_batch_size=8 at 2024-11-06T09:30:05Z by devon

devon (eng-runtime): Change applied. Monitoring metrics: enqueue_time p95 dropped from 1.4s -> 420ms within 90s. queue_depth trending down from 512 to ~120.

tim (customer-ops): Confirming on our side — error rate dropping, latency better. Thanks.

lisa (sre): Next steps for root cause: we should capture a longer trace for long seq requests, check KV cache warmup patterns, and evaluate whether continuous-batcher backpressure thresholds need raising or adaptive eviction.

raj (eng-oncall): Can someone run the on-host batcher trace command and attach the artifact?

devon (eng-runtime): Running diagnostic now:
```
kubectl -n inference exec -it batcher-usw2-0 -- \ 
  sh -c "grep -E 'enqueue_time|batchers_backlog|kvcache_miss' /var/log/batcher.log | tail -n 500" > /tmp/batcher_usw2_trace.txt
```
Artifact uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-debug/INC-8912/batcher_usw2_trace_20241106.tar.gz

amy (support): Added customer repro steps to ticket: reproduce with a burst script sending 300 concurrent small requests (sequence length varies). Provided sample script and reduced tokens test.

raj (eng-oncall): Long-term: schedule a postmortem to decide whether default queue_depth=512 is too conservative for mixed long-short workloads. Also consider per-tenant adaptive routing based on observed seq-length distribution.

amy (support): Customer updated and monitoring looks stable for ~10m. Assigning to eng-runtime for follow-up. Closing urgent escalation state. :white_check_mark:

lisa (sre): Added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-saturation ; recommend runbook tweak: include a step to route-to-low-latency variant before scaling.

devon (eng-runtime): Filed follow-up ticket ENG-4027 to evaluate adaptive batching and queue-depth autoscaling thresholds.

amy (support): Closing thread here — will update INC-8912 with notes. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
